entries.description: Words copied from the brief appear on screen (the prompt is direction, not script).
entries.owner_note: Probe prompt put 'Make a dynamic showreel' / 'GO ALL OUT' on screen.
entries.fix_policy: Drop the echoing text; the bridge re-plans the headline from the brief's meaning.

entries.description: A caption repeats labels or numbers already on screen (q2, q3, q4, every, 22%).
entries.owner_note: board_reel captions spelled q1..q4 and +22% beside the chart that shows them.
entries.fix_policy: Captions say what the data means, never repeat it; drop echoing caption words.

entries.description: Technical or self-referential strings on screen (fps, bpm, track name, engine or program name).
entries.owner_note: '24 FPS / 126 BPM', 'DRIVING PULSE', 'BOARD REEL', 'MOTIONENGINE 2' in the corners.
entries.fix_policy: Never render meta; drop the text (HUD corners included).

entries.description: A typing reveal is cut by the next shot or holds a partial word (overshoo, dampin, quar).
entries.owner_note: Captions shown half-typed at the cut.
entries.fix_policy: Per-letter delay min(0.05, 0.4·len/n); a word is whole for at least one beat.

entries.description: Text cut by the frame or a mask, or outside the 5 % title-safe inset.
entries.owner_note: 'FLOW' and the top mono line run off the left edge.
entries.fix_policy: Ctx::text shifts lines into the safe area; repair: the title steps down a size.

entries.description: Text shares its value with the pattern under it (black on black halftone).
entries.owner_note: Black '+22%' / 'settle' merge into black dots.
entries.fix_policy: Palette resolver: texture is a shade/tint of its ground (1.08-1.35:1), never the ink; dL texture-ink >= 0.45. Repair: a halftone under the type becomes a grid.

entries.description: A dot field reads over or through solid shapes (grey dots on grey bars).
entries.owner_note: Dots visible over the bars.
entries.fix_policy: Texture is drawn under the content it surrounds (component order); it is never cleared around it.

entries.description: Unanchored decorative circle with no relation to content.
entries.owner_note: Big orange/blue circles on top of the diagram.
entries.fix_policy: Static shapes must anchor (ring/underline/marker on measured bounds).

entries.description: A small label or kicker above a hero title or a cliché line (SELECTED WORK, designer / 2026, 3-2-1-GO).
entries.owner_note: worlds_reel opening.
entries.fix_policy: Drop the kicker/cliché component.

entries.description: A box or panel behind type that is not the content itself.
entries.owner_note: v1 cards and panels behind every title.
entries.fix_policy: No decorative boxes; cards only where the box is the content (diagram cards).

entries.description: Flicker or pulsing to the music.
entries.owner_note: Shapes pulsing on every kick.
entries.fix_policy: No pulse/shake ops in v2; beat sync is cuts and steps.

entries.description: Beats play after the last visual event, or the ending is not a downbeat hit.
entries.owner_note: board_reel froze on 'CUT.' for 3 beats while the track ran.
entries.fix_policy: Coverage to the full duration, gap <= 1, end_beat on the final downbeat, bed fades on the hit.

entries.description: Nothing visibly changes for a beat (or a near-blank frame).
entries.owner_note: board_reel 9-11 s, worlds_reel 5.5 / 7.5 s.
entries.fix_policy: Overlap shots; something changes every beat.

entries.description: A counter still ticking on a held frame, so values disagree (21% vs 22%).
entries.owner_note: '+21%' then '+22%' on the same bar.
entries.fix_policy: Counts finish with the bar growth (<= 0.4 s) or show the final value.

entries.description: Reference hairlines below 3:1 (read as artefacts).
entries.owner_note: 10 % guides on the dark board.
entries.fix_policy: Stroke contrast >= 3:1 or no stroke (design-system session owns the colours).

entries.description: The hero fills too little of the frame (small, centred).
entries.owner_note: Charts and diagrams at 10-40 % of the frame.
entries.fix_policy: Hero area >= 45 % of the frame after the camera.

entries.description: Text revealed before the voice says it (v1 speech-led videos).
entries.owner_note: v1 reels showed words early.
entries.fix_policy: v1 speech planner; v2 has no voice track yet.

entries.description: Empty space kept for content that has not arrived yet (a band for a later row, room for a callout, a hole in a texture before its label).
entries.owner_note: Layout must never anticipate: reserved space for elements that haven't arrived feels staged and fake.
entries.detector: static:anticipatory_space (lowers the program truncated to what is visible and compares the composition centre just before each arrival; > 3% of the short side fails)
entries.fix_policy: Layout follows content: lay out each step from the visible elements only and spring between layouts (flip::follow); arriving elements make their room on arrival; knockouts/clearances arrive with their element.

entries.description: Type below its contrast band against the pixels actually behind it (7:1 under 48 px, 4.5:1 display).
entries.owner_note: "The background and the text should be of contrasting colour."
entries.fix_policy: Palette resolver derives ink per ground; layout::enforce_roles sets the role that reads on every backing the run is shown on. Repair: the run goes back to ink.

entries.description: The ground under a run of type is busy (OKLab L std-dev > 0.06).
entries.owner_note: "+21%" half on dots.
entries.fix_policy: Palette (texture <= 1.35:1) and composition: calm_focus puts a halftone's dense side away from the type, once per shot. Never a local hole. Repair: halftone -> grid.

entries.description: A texture is cut, cleared or faded around an element (a hole, a band, a ring), soft or hard.
entries.owner_note: "This pattern where we are removing the background designs feels forced and breaks the scene" (RHYTHM tiles cleared around the title; a band cleared under the curve).
entries.fix_policy: Never clear texture. Legibility comes from the palette (texture <= 1.35:1, ink >= 7:1); a pattern too strong for type is composed once per shot (its sparse side where the type lives) or dimmed uniformly.

entries.description: A stroke or curve below 3:1 against what is behind it (black curve on black dots, faint axes).
entries.owner_note: Axes nearly invisible; black curve on black halftone.
entries.fix_policy: Axes and base lines are strong structure (>= 3:1) at >= 2 px; enforce_roles lifts strokes below 3:1; texture clears around curves. Repair: the component drops its colour override.

entries.description: The accent covers more than 10 % of the frame (60-30-10).
entries.owner_note: Design-system rule (DESIGN_COLOR_SYSTEM.md).
entries.fix_policy: One accent, on the one highlighted thing. Repair: accent shapes step down to m, stressed words lose the accent.

entries.description: More than 3 hue families in one video.
entries.owner_note: Design-system rule (DESIGN_COLOR_SYSTEM.md).
entries.fix_policy: Palette resolver hue budget: grounds past three families become neutrals of the same lightness.

entries.description: A decorative element (texture, hairline) out-contrasts the focal type.
entries.owner_note: Design-system rule (DESIGN_COLOR_SYSTEM.md).
entries.fix_policy: Texture capped at 1.35:1, decorative structure at 2:1. Repair: the run goes back to ink.

entries.description: Settled type outside the 5 % title-safe inset.
entries.owner_note: Design-system rule (DESIGN_COLOR_SYSTEM.md).
entries.fix_policy: Ctx::text shifts lines into the safe area. Repair: the title steps down a size.

entries.description: A label sits off its container's centre (cap band low, ink off x).
entries.owner_note: 'the button text is not centred': Hold to send 13.5 px low, Sent 20.5 px low (Ctx::text clamped group-local coords). (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: UI labels centre on the cap band (+0.5 px optical drop) and the ink x; Ctx::text never clamps (text_canvas does, top level only).

entries.description: A character the type faces do not have renders as a fallback (✓ ✔ √ ✗, arrows, emoji).
entries.owner_note: 'the sent tick is not proper': '✓' drawn by a fallback face. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Validator bans the glyphs in titles; ticks are UiState.icon: check, a vector path drawn on.

entries.description: The camera moves but every layer is pinned, so nothing on screen moves.
entries.owner_note: Device group sized to the canvas was pinned by pin_grounds; the zoom-to-state never showed. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Device groups carry explicit depth and their hardware bounds; pin_grounds skips explicit depth.

entries.description: Two UI states' content visible at once (> 15 % each).
entries.owner_note: 'Pay' over 'Send to Mira'; old content 64 % visible when the new arrives. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Old content leaves in 0.10 s OutCubic; new content arrives after it.

entries.description: A colour change passes through a dull mix (OKLCH L and chroma under both ends).
entries.owner_note: Dead grey at 2.07 s, navy at 6.77 s from sRGB-lerped fills. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Colour changes are a circular reveal of the new fill from the tap, never a cross-fade or tint lerp.

entries.description: Content spills outside the morphing container.
entries.owner_note: Content scaled from 1.06 with no mask outside the container mid-morph. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Content groups are masked to the container path on the same spring; enter 0.98 to 1.

entries.description: A tap lands outside its shape or within 0.25 h of its edge.
entries.owner_note: The cursor clicked outside the button (0.47 w / 0.44 h); 'Ink & grain' tapped for 'Paper cut-out'. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Taps land inside with margin, on the row the next state names, else the CTA, else clear of the label.

entries.description: A tap ripple under 3:1 on what it lands on.
entries.owner_note: Accent ripple on an accent button. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: The ripple takes the ink role of the tapped fill.

entries.description: A UI state under 15 % of the screen and under 45 % of the frame width once settled.
entries.owner_note: A 3.5 %-of-screen button in a giant empty phone. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Real iOS sizes; the camera frames every state (62 % width in 16:9, 80 % in 9:16, 46 % beside type).

entries.description: A floating surface with a hairline outline, or with no shadow and under 1.3:1 on the screen.
entries.owner_note: Low-contrast grey sheet cut out by a 2 px hairline. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: White (or raised) surfaces lifted by the kit's shadow stack; no strokes on containers.

entries.description: Over 1 s with nothing moving at the end of a UI shot.
entries.owner_note: A 3.3 s static tail after 'Hold to send'. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Every hold gets a slow monotonic 3 % push; nothing pulses.

entries.description: The cursor visible and still for over 1 s.
entries.owner_note: The cursor idled 3.3 s at the end. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: The finger fades between distant taps and leaves 0.4 s after the last one.

entries.description: UI type set in one weight only.
entries.owner_note: One heavy weight for everything. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: One UI sans (Satoshi) in two weights: 700 titles and labels, 500 body and rows.

entries.description: A spring cut before it settles to 98 %.
entries.owner_note: 0.6 s morphs cut to 0.43 s, content springs cut, a 0.3 s press spring. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Steps at least 0.45 s apart; spring durations cover their settle; holds validated against read time.

entries.description: A state replaced before it can be read (0.4 s + 0.3 s a line).
entries.owner_note: A 4-line card shown 0.47 s; one state per beat. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Validator: every state holds its read time; beats are filled by type, not new states.

entries.description: A tap that changes nothing within 0.5 s.
entries.owner_note: Beat 15 clicked and nothing happened. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Every tap presses its target (morph, row tint) or changes state.

entries.description: Over 4 UI type sizes, or one role at different sizes.
entries.owner_note: Sizes fitted per box; no scale. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Fixed pt scale 22/17/15/13 (+56 hero number), one size per role.

entries.description: Ctx::text moves type inside a group (frame safe-area clamp on group-local coords).
entries.owner_note: Labels pushed down inside buttons; also hit chart, diagram and kinetic type. (UI_KIT_REVIEW, phone_flow/ui_promo a3e7932)
entries.fix_policy: Ctx::text is unclamped; Ctx::text_canvas clamps top-level type only.

entries.description: System text on the actor's device speaks from the other person's side ('Mira received') or names the actor as a third party.
entries.owner_note: phone_flow ended with 'Mira received EUR 24.00' on the sender's own phone. (blueprint, 2026-10-14)
entries.fix_policy: Flows are typed (flow.kind + actor/counterparty): copy is derived from the actor's point of view ('Sent to Mira'); free-text states are validated.

entries.description: Two success affordances at once (a tick and a confirming banner, two ticks).
entries.owner_note: The 'Sent' pill and the 'received' banner, two ticks together. (blueprint, 2026-10-14)
entries.fix_policy: Success resolves in place: button, tick, in-app receipt. A notification only brings later news from the counterparty.

entries.description: Mid-flow, the screen holds only chrome and one floating element: the app vanished.
entries.owner_note: After sending, the phone showed nothing but a floating 'Sent' pill. (blueprint, 2026-10-14)
entries.fix_policy: On phones and laptops every state after the first is a card or sheet that keeps the app's context; success transforms it in place.

entries.description: A notification repeats what the screen already shows (the amount, the same names and words).
entries.owner_note: The banner restated the amount and recipient already on screen. (blueprint, 2026-10-14)
entries.fix_policy: A notification carries new information (flow.reply: the counterparty's later action) or is left out.

entries.description: The same image cutout asset is stamped multiple times inside a single scene/shot.
entries.owner_note: WordMorph shots repeated the same cutout at top and bottom-right like clip-art stamps.
entries.fix_policy: Each image asset ID may appear at most once per scene; WordMorph pairs at most one cutout per phase.

entries.description: Kicker text inside a component: a bento header above the grid (LAST YEAR, IN NUMBERS) or a lockup pill (EST. 2019) is an eyebrow too
entries.owner_note: Kicker text inside a component: a bento header above the grid (LAST YEAR, IN NUMBERS) or a lockup pill (EST. 2019) is an eyebrow too (seen in output/replicate/studio/original.mp4)
entries.fix_policy: Drop the kicker text (the bento header, the lockup badge or spec line); keep the component.
